units.source_text: 日色近暮，雷电稍息，惟风势到夜犹不停止。

en.t: As dusk drew near, the thunder and lightning eased a little, but the wind still did not stop even after night fell.

units.source_text: 雷雨停息，想是诵经礼佛愿力深宏之故吧。

en.t: The thunderstorm had calmed, perhaps because the power of their sutra chanting and prayers to the Buddha was so profound.

units.source_text: 大家互相告道：“这雷雨如果再不停息，我等势必被浪涛卷去。

en.t: Everyone said to one another, "If this thunderstorm does not stop soon, we will surely be swept away by the waves.

units.source_text: 这便是所谓海啸，能在顷刻之间害人。

en.t: This must be what people call a tsunami, something that can destroy lives in an instant.

units.source_text: 以前只是传闻，却终未见过此种骇人之事，此次才目击了。”

en.t: Before, we had only heard rumors of such terrifying things and had never actually seen one; now we have witnessed it for ourselves."
